requirement: No cloning, recursive directory copy, file content cache, or configuration writes.
No archive inspection, binary introspection, full-text search, metadata filtering, or special case-insensitive filesystem handling. Binary files remain copyable and displayable as bytes.
No custom credential store or authentication flow; use gh credentials. No GitHub Enterprise host support in v1.
Discovery does not support recursive globs, license or star filters, or fork deduplication.
Remote results reflect API observations and are not guaranteed real-time snapshots across repositories.
Never overwrite an existing destination without --force. No interactive overwrite confirmation.
